design_note_zh: 标签用于公开任务图集。Tools 指场景中的物理工具及候选，不表示每条参考路线都会使用；不把 SDK、IK/FK 或执行回退 L1–L3 混作物理工具或难度层。难度采用提案的三层场景设计，保留有来源的声明层；其余待分层。不向被评测 agent 透露层号。
design_note_en: Tags describe the public task gallery. Tools are physical tools and candidates present in the scene, not necessarily used by every reference route. SDKs, IK/FK and execution-fallback L1–L3 are separate. Difficulty follows the proposal’s three cumulative scene layers: source-declared layers are retained and other configurations remain unclassified. Layer numbers are not disclosed to the evaluated agent.
